It began on March 10, 2012 and ended on November 3, 2012.[http://sports.sina.com.cn/b/2011-12-17/10355871904.shtml 中国足协提高中甲准入制 新赛季中超3月10日开幕] {{in lang|zh}} The matches that were intended to be held on September 15 and 16, 2012 were suspended for a later date due to an international dispute between China and [[Japan]] over the [[Senkaku Islands]].{{cite news |title=Matches across the country cancelled due to “sensitive time” |date=September 2012 |work=wildeastfootball.net |url=http://wildeastfootball.net/2012/09/matches-across-the-country-cancelled-due-to-sensitive-time/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121115204359/http://wildeastfootball.net/2012/09/matches-across-the-country-cancelled-due-to-sensitive-time/ |archive-date=November 15, 2012 |url-status=usurped}} With [[Zhejiang Professional F.C.|Hangzhou Greentown]] having a Japanese manager and several [[2012 anti-Japanese demonstrations in China|Chinese demonstrations]] arising throughout China it was decided that the September 23, 2012 match against [[Liaoning F.C.|Liaoning Whowin]] should be played [[Behind closed doors (sport)|behind closed doors]] with the Xianghe National Football Training Base used as a neutral venue.[http://sports.sohu.com/20120923/n353774296.shtml 杨旭传射东欧锋霸戴帽 辽足4–0完胜绿城 图　评] {{in lang|zh}} == Promotion and relegation == '''Teams promoted from [[2011 China League One]]''' * [[Dalian Professional F.C.|Dalian Aerbin]] * [[Guangzhou City F.C.|Guangzhou R&F]] '''Teams relegated to [[2012 China League One]]''' * [[Chengdu Tiancheng F.C.|Chengdu Blades]] * [[Shenzhen F.C.|Shenzhen Ruby]] ==Teams== ===Clubs and locations=== {| class="wikitable sortable" style="font-size:95%" |- !
